niche: a port authority's on-road NOx inventory for the roadway links around its terminals, each link's program-year vehicle-miles by class expanded from short classification counts, the terminal access roads' trucks following their terminal's vessel calls rather than the state stations' calendar, to designate links for its 2027 air-corridor program
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the count programmes and station records, reads every field and rule correctly and expands every link's count class by class with the classifying stations' monthly and day-of-week factors (the traffic monitoring guide's method) designates the wrong links, because the trucks on the three terminal access roads come and go with their terminal's vessel calls, which the state stations never see, so an access road counted in a busy week or a quiet one is carried into the year at that week's level; the terminals' own gate records measure it.
domain_test: The decisive quantity is each link's program-year NOx per mile, an on-road inventory's class vehicle-miles times class emission rates, the vehicle-miles expanded from short counts; for the terminal access roads the field's step is recognising that their trucks are generated by the terminal, so the expansion follows the terminal's own activity record rather than the continuous count stations' calendar factors.
layer2_pattern: own:short counts on single-generator roads expanded by the generator's own activity record, the reference-station calendar factors invalid for that group

world.geography: United States, a fictional coastal metropolitan area

driver: A period total at most sites follows the calendar pattern measured at always-on reference sites, but at the few sites that serve a single facility it follows that facility's own activity, which swings with an external schedule the reference sites never see; the facility's transaction record measures the swing, so those sites' two-day samples are expanded by the facility's activity on the sample days against its year, while expanding them by the reference calendar carries a busy or quiet week into the year.
driver_concrete: Each roadway link's NOx per mile is class vehicle-miles times class rates; the miles come from 48-hour counts expanded with the classifying stations' class factors, except that the combination trucks on the three terminal access roads are expanded by the ratio of their terminal's average daily gate visits over the year to its visits on the count days, because those trucks follow vessel calls.

lineage.driver: A unit's period total is measured hourly by an instrument that shares a utility with the unit's control device, so when the utility fails the instrument goes dark while the control is off; the dark hours are filled at the uncontrolled level the instrument reads in its first hours back, times the hour's metered input, rather than from the unit's measured hours in the same operating state or from the hours either side, which the controlled hours dominate.
lineage.stump: The default path fills every unmonitored hour from the unit's own measured hours in the same start state and load, and designates AF-2, CB-1, DF-1, DF-3 and SR-1; the gaps that came with the plants' instrument air trips are hours when the SCR's air-operated ammonia valves had closed as well, which the first measured hour after each trip shows at about twenty times the controlled rate, so filling those hours at that uncontrolled level adds CB-2 and AF-1.

lineage.driver: A unit's period total is measured hourly by an instrument that is out mostly in the hours after the unit starts, when the quantity runs several times its steady level at the same operating point, so the missing hours are filled by the hour's start state, read from an every-hour operating log, rather than by a fit on the operating point that the steady hours dominate.
lineage.stump: The default path fills each unmonitored hour from the unit's NOx-on-load regression and designates the units that run steadily high, because the analyzers drop out mostly right after a start, when the cold catalyst lets NOx run at several times the steady rate; filling the missing hours by hours since start designates the hard-cycling units the program should fund.
